title: Qualify native ICC curves and an RGB matrix/TRC path
body:
Parent: #13216. Follow the native ICC feasibility decision #13657 and a qualified envelope inspector.

Implement and qualify isolated XYZ/curve readers before a restricted RGB matrix/TRC transform.
Each implementation slice requires its own READY PR and normal exact-head merge before dependent work.

Acceptance:

- [ ] Check exact signed fixed-point coefficients and every admitted identity, gamma, sampled, or parametric curve form independently.
- [ ] Check branch points, endpoints, nonfinite results, invalid domains, curve counts, and explicit admission restrictions.
- [ ] Admit only qualified v4.4 RGB input/display matrix/TRC models with XYZ PCS and explicit media-relative colorimetric selection.
- [ ] Preserve tag-selection precedence and reject unsupported LUT, PCS, intent, or model combinations without a silent sRGB fallback.
- [ ] Define destination, D50 adaptation, clipping, alpha, filtering order, and black-point policy before a transform campaign.
- [ ] Predeclare finite numerical/byte criteria and compare with independent high-precision math and pinned offline LittleCMS, retaining every discrepancy.
- [ ] Qualify malformed inputs, cancellation, ownership, source/tool immutability, and native/Wasm/ARM execution before encoded-image integration.

General ICC compatibility, photographs, physical/process bounds, performance, security, and production acceptance require separate evidence.
An external runtime CMM requires explicit user approval.

Progress (2026-10-27): #13664 preserves exact XYZ/curve wire values, and #13668 evaluates identity, positive-gamma, and sampled curv data.
The finite 1,049-case three-target campaign passes its predeclared 1e-12 criterion, with exact identities and 396 balanced zero-live workers.
Parametric curves, complete model admission, destination/adaptation policy, and transforms remain open.
CI40452246319 was pending at the normal exact-head merge, not a pass.

Bounded parametric progress (2026-10-27): #13670 evaluates all five current functions within the subset declared by #13669 before implementation.
Its source-pinned three-target finite campaign passes 1,497 cases per target with 564 nonzero balanced zero-live workers.
The maximum observed absolute error is 1.1102145542946743e-16 against the unchanged 1e-12 finite criterion.
Wider affine fractional-gamma domains, complete model admission, destination/adaptation policy, and transforms remain open.
CI40455480207 was pending at normal exact-head merge, not a pass.

Isolated matrix progress (2026-10-27): #13673 qualifies signed fixed-point multiplication for explicit finite linear RGB values.
Its finite 2,015-case campaign passes on three targets, with a maximum one-step difference against the predeclared two-step criterion.
Exact projections and specified dyadic values retain exact bits, and all 756 workers have nonzero balanced zero-live heaps.
This kernel does not establish model admission, rendering intent, destination, adaptation, or complete transform eligibility.
CI40464899082 was queued at normal exact-head merge, not a pass.

Owned ICC data selection progress (2026-10-27): #13678 implements native child #13674 under #13659.
The source-pinned 401-case three-target campaign checks 435,297 returned integers per target exactly, with 153 balanced zero-live workers.
Its explicit intent and no-forward-LUT-fallback policies select owned bounded data without complete profile conformance or transform eligibility.
Text/adaptation semantics, transforms, metadata-bearing JPEG integration, and all actual M5/epic acceptance gates remain open.
CI40473894548 was pending at normal exact-head merge, not a pass.


ICC scalar composition progress (2026-10-27): #13684 completes native child #13683 under #13659.
It merged normally at `9be369822099d322b4be9842c5eecddc8750162e`, with exact head `aece3c67a37eb26db06a1754faa52bd51ba1ed0f`.
CI run 40490551868 was queued at the last pre-merge read, not a pass.

Source `581469fb562de3c41890722a986b65e49726f644` precedes all final campaigns.
Each target passes 2,824 cases, including 2,709 numeric results, 115 expected errors, and 1,264 applicable host-side offline CMM observations.
All 1,059 fresh Fern workers report nonzero balanced zero-live heaps.
Target sample records agree exactly, and all selected source/tool hashes remain unchanged.

All predeclared component, derived, and secondary CMM criteria pass without tolerance changes.
The maximum secondary CMM difference is approximately `6.09e-7`, within the predeclared `1e-6` finite criterion.
All 282 TAP cases pass on each target, with 79 native, 55 Wasm, and 40 ARM balanced zero-live heap censuses.
Go check/interpreter, unchanged complexity gates, format/build/vet/lint checks, nine protocol tests, and exact reference reproduction pass.

Evidence: `fern-image/docs/icc-matrix-trc.md`, `fern-image/benchmarks/icc-matrix-trc-2026-10-27/`, and three new raw `icc-matrix-trc-*` records.
This scalar API returns actual linear RGB and unclipped relative D50 XYZ, without additional adaptation, destination RGB, or encoded-image integration.
It adds no runtime CMM dependency.
It does not certify complete profile conformance, exact CMM parity, physical/process bounds, or production acceptance.
All actual parent M5 and epic acceptance gates remain open.
